title: Selling a House in a Houston Historic District
description: Selling a historic Houston house? Verify its designation and exterior-work requirements before comparing renovation with a current-condition offer.

faq.q: Does an old house automatically have a City historic designation?
faq.a: Do not assume so. Verify the specific property's district and designation status with official City resources or preservation staff.

faq.q: Should I replace windows before selling a designated historic house?
faq.a: Confirm the actual project requirements before ordering work. Ask preservation staff about the property's classification and proposed exterior change.

faq.q: Does a Certificate of Appropriateness replace every building permit?
faq.a: No. Ask which preservation and other approvals apply to the project. Do not treat one approval as clearance for every kind of work.

faq.q: Does selling as-is remove historic-property restrictions?
faq.a: No. A current-condition purchase discussion does not eliminate applicable requirements or authorize later construction or demolition.
